title: Simple Rope
description: A simple mod that adds rope to climb up and down from ledges.
body:
This mod adds one item: rope. It can be placed on the side or underside of blocks, and more rope can be dropped down from there. It can also be pulled back up.

The idea behind this mod is to create an easier way to climb down from ledges (for example, in a cave or on a tower) without having to use something like a waterfall. I also wanted to make a mod that is as simple as possible and integrates well with the vanilla experience.

To use: Craft rope using these recipes:

![Three wool placed vertically crafts six rope.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d805fcaaacd87bbe2598bd610561b90dbf42c5c6.png)![Three vines placed vertically crafts two rope.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be468bc2ed71aab8cff4276a78022b97c90f3af8.png)

As of version 1.1.0, you can also craft rope using a similar recipe (a line of 3 vertically) with weeping vines or twisting vines.

Place rope on the side or bottom of a solid block. Right click on the rope hook or anywhere on the rope with more rope to extend it. Right click with an empty hand to pull it back up. You can climb on the rope just like a ladder or vine.

![A picture of two ropes, one hanging from the side of a block and one hanging from the bottom of a block.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cccbb1de9b6f0d28f8c156b173187666dff27dfb_0.webp)



Made by Yeremyo (programmer) and Proking235 (artist)
